description.en: Host bundle that leaves work inside the workspace untouched and judges only the extra permission a call asks for: reads, network traffic, temp files, package caches and project writes pass; system state changes and writes outside the project ask once, with a deterministic impact analysis; machine- or session-destroying actions are refused; at most one confirmation is outstanding at a time.
description.zh: Host bundle：工作区内的操作完全不参与，只判定调用额外申请的权限——读取、网络通信、临时文件、包缓存与项目内写入放行；改动系统状态或写入项目之外时确认一次，并附确定性影响分析；会毁机器或断会话的动作直接拒绝；同一时刻只有一个确认。
